quotes.text:
/**
   * This decodes parameter values according to RFC 2231.
   *
   * This flag means nothing if HEADER_PARAMETER is not specified.
   */
  HEADER_OPTION_DECODE_2231: 0x10,
  /**
   * This decodes the inline encoded-words that are in RFC 2047.
   */
  HEADER_OPTION_DECODE_2047: 0x20,
  /**
   * This converts the header from a raw string to proper Unicode.
   */
  HEADER_OPTION_ALLOW_RAW: 0x40,

  // Convenience for all three of the above.
  HEADER_OPTION_ALL_I18N: 0x70,

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 1032 removes RFC 2231 decoding flags from address and unstructured header calls and replaces HEADER_OPTION_ALL_I18N with ALLOW_RAW plus DECODE_2047 where appropriate. parseHeaderField only uses DECODE_2231 in HEADER_PARAMETER; address and unstructured branches ignore it. Keep the effective flags explicit so the call does not imply support it lacks. This is a readability rule beyond formatting, and the checked behavior supports the commit's no-functional-change description.
title: Specify only the MIME options that affect the selected header parser
